svg.title: Molecule of the day: Dextromethorphan
svg.desc: A rotating 3D structure of Dextromethorphan while a graph neural network predicts its lipophilicity (logD) as 3.03.
svg.text: MW 271.4 · cLogP 3.38 · TPSA 12.5 · HBD 0 · HBA 2 · RotB 1
3-layer message-passing GNN · 4,200 molecules · held-out RMSE 0.603 (R² 0.731) · descriptors from RDKit
